integrity: Analytic lower bounds and explicit constructions establish the claims. Bounded standard-library computations verify candidate models and small optimum costs; no formal certificate or expert attestation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected graphs and total premise-plus-conclusion literal cost. Geodetic graphs attain the universal lower bound, but the converse fails. Cycle counts treat vertices as labelled and bases as sets of implications. The minimum weight of arbitrary nongeodetic graphs is not classified.
title: Exact literal-cost Horn bases on geodetic graphs and cycles
